definitions.anchor_only: One FUNCTION anchor and no other semantic structure; visibility/unknown observability may coexist.
definitions.counts: Canonical nodes/edges (not callsite multiplicities); unresolved occurrences also reported separately.
definitions.degraded_observability: Observed unresolved calls, local truncation, or unavailable visibility counts, as in Step 6/7. Unknown is not zero. No fingerprint motif-budget truncation inferred from canonical input.
definitions.interaction_capable: Explicit calls_function edge whose callee is source of calls_api/references_string/uses_constant/belongs_to_section (Step 6).
definitions.scope: Read-only signal audit; categories overlap; no labels, exclusions, similarity or malware inference.
